notes: Windows v1.1.44 combined update: update checks still run every 10 minutes, but a newer package is now downloaded and SHA-256/size/payload verified in the background without changing an active session. Installation is deferred to the safe boundary after the current session is credited and all bot-owned tabs are closed. The bot atomically checkpoints Excel paths and fingerprints, per-account repeat counts, class selection, Hindi/Math schedule, tab limit and pairing state without storing passwords; a detached Windows helper backs up and replaces the bot, rolls back on failure, restarts it, rebuilds the queue and continues at the next unfinished session. Includes strict maacc.diagnostic.v1 JSONL with stable run/batch/tab/file/account mappings and explicit updater, timer, network, recovery, abort, completion and progress-commit events, with authentication image tokens redacted and legacy text normalized into JSON. Retains the v1.1.43 Aagey/Shuru timer trigger, Internet recovery timing, equal repeat progress compartments, 70-tab limit, removed Voice indicator and removed event audio.
